'''Pad''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenary and a non-[[The Force/Legends|Force sensitive]] member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Pad fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp. While scavenging treasures and supplies, the group of mercenaries Pad was with was attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

Pad was [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with [[Derrin]], as they stood guard at the Sith camp by a direct [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike to the body.
